== Summary ==
A group outside the hotel at the [[2009 World Championship]], October 2009, with nickname labels added by [[Jerry Heine]] (quesosauce37), who first posted it. Identified: [[Jerry Heine]] ("Sauce", front, crouching), [[Thomas McGee]] ("McGee", green cap), [[Kevin Shannon]] ("Ultra Scrubb", hand raised), [[Brian Fred]] ("Bfred", black cap, Houston Texans shirt), [[Chris Schoenthal]] ("Shoenthall", brown cap) and [[Dan Kim]] (maroon T-shirt, arms crossed, centre front). The label on Kim, hidden under the watermark, reads "Nice Guy" (his 2009 username MrNiceGuy). The unlabelled original is [[:File:2009 World Championship group outside 2.jpg]].

First posted by quesosauce37: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=483670#p483670 post 483670], 16 November 2009. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261105005202/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t31192.html Internet Archive]
Posted on the Players Committee forum by BrenDerlin: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=484120#p484120 post 484120], "Pics [Worlds 09]" (topic 31192), 18 November 2009 (quoting quesosauce37). Photobucket album jerryfromdenver, image wrols.jpg (album jerryfromdenver). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261105005202/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t31192.html Internet Archive]
* '''Watermark:''' This copy carries the Groupsy/Photobucket watermark that Photobucket stamped on re-served images; no unwatermarked copy was found (the Photobucket album is no longer public).
